question: Where did I go on a week-long trip with my family?

gold_sessions.user_turns:
[turn 0] I'm trying to plan a new trip and I'm torn between going solo or with family. Can you give me some suggestions on destinations that are good for both solo travelers and families?

[turn 2] I'm actually thinking of going back to Hawaii, I loved it so much when I went with my family for a week last month! Do you have any suggestions for things to do on the Big Island?

[turn 4] I'm actually thinking of staying in Kailua-Kona this time, I want to explore the town and do some coffee farm tours. Do you have any recommendations for accommodations in Kailua-Kona that are good for solo travelers and also have a laid-back, local vibe?

[turn 6] I'll definitely check out those accommodations and coffee farms. I'm also thinking of visiting the Hilo Farmers Market on Saturday. Do you think it's worth taking a day trip to Hilo from Kailua-Kona?

[turn 8] Yeah, I think I'll definitely take a day trip to Hilo. I've heard great things about the farmers market and I'd love to check out Rainbow Falls. Do you have any recommendations for lunch in Hilo?

[turn 10] I'm thinking of trying some of the local specialties like laulau and kalua pig while I'm in Hilo. Do you have any recommendations for places that serve traditional Hawaiian dishes?
